messages:
rachel_devex: Heads up — received two tickets where installing from git fails: `pip install git+https://github.com/redwood/repo.git@main` errors with
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for redwood-sdk, which is required to install pyproject.toml-based projects
```
kevin_eng: do we still publish with poetry-core? Pip-from-VCS often fails when pip/build are old and poetry-core is used. Also if we don't ship mac/arm wheels pip will try to compile native deps and fail.
mina_pkg: pyproject currently lists `poetry-core` as build-backend. Short-term workaround for users: `python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel build` then `python -m build && pip install dist/*.whl`. For poetry users: `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes -o reqs.txt && pip install -r reqs.txt`.
kevin_eng: we also had a report where `from redwood import AsyncClient` raised ImportError after pip install. That worked in editable installs which masks missing exports in the built sdist/wheel.
mina_pkg: fixable with three small changes: 1) export AsyncClient at package top-level (`from .async_client import AsyncClient` in redwood/__init__.py), 2) include typing marker `redwood/py.typed` in packaging (MANIFEST.in or tool.poetry.include), 3) consider switching build-system to setuptools+wheel or document pip>=23 requirement.
alex_support: I'll send the workaround to the ticket owners and ask them to try the wheel path. Can we publish a patch wheel once CI is green?
ci-bot: packaging validation failed on macos-arm64 for PR #1426 — build step errored. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/1426
kevin_eng: minimal PR proposal: export AsyncClient in __init__, add `include redwood/py.typed` to MANIFEST.in (and pyproject include for poetry), and add a CI smoke test that creates a clean venv, `pip install dist/*.whl`, then runs `python -c "from redwood import AsyncClient; import pkgutil; print(bool(pkgutil.get_data('redwood','py.typed')))"`. That should catch regressions quickly.
rachel_devex: sounds good. I'll open the PR and update INSTALL.md with a short note: "VCS installs require pip>=23 or build with setuptools; prefer wheel installs or use poetry export for reproducible installs." Will ping affected users when the wheel is published. :thumbsup:
